tools.name: search_beevr
tools.description: Search BeevR services, shipped case studies and articles (AI agents, MVP cost, HIPAA/PCI compliance, offshore development in Vietnam). Returns ranked matches with URLs.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get BeevR fixed-price packages (Pitch Demo, Investor MVP, Flagship Sprint) with price, duration and what is included.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List BeevR services (AI agent development, AI development, MVP development, HIPAA and fintech MVPs, custom software, offshore development in Vietnam) with summaries and URLs.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: List production systems BeevR has shipped (healthcare AI, security agent, AI B2B matchmaking, fintech payments, manufacturing) with key results and stack.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Get the full write-up of one BeevR case study as Markdown, by slug (from list_case_studies).

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List BeevR blog articles (newest first), optionally filtered by a keyword query.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one BeevR blog article as Markdown, by slug (from list_articles or search_beevr).

tools.name: about_beevr
tools.description: Who BeevR is, its AI capabilities (production agents, HIPAA AI, GraphRAG, Kite framework) and how to contact the team.
